title: Prague: on the dot
old_caption: Virgo brought a clipboard to an astronomical clock and judged the little figures' spacing. The date ran late with two cocoas. The checklist got edited. Fair trade?

title: Kyoto: the perfect garden
old_caption: Every line in Libra's garden was perfect, and so was the silence. Then came the footprints. Sometimes the person who messes up your pattern is the one who helps draw the next one.

title: Minneapolis: the skyway
old_caption: Scorpio watched the same crush from the skyway every day and ducked every time. The crush noticed. Of course the crush noticed. What's the longest you've admired someone from a skyway?

title: Sapporo: built together
old_caption: Sag sculpted a mountain, a ship and a rocket for their future adventures. The rocket sagged. Then Virgo showed up with a bucket and it turned into the best trip yet. Sag, would you stay for this?

title: Denver: the top
old_caption: Capricorn's plan: promotion, savings, peak, then love. The view from the top was great and very windy. The cocoa was at the bottom the whole time. Which Capricorn needs to see this?

title: Montreal: look down
old_caption: Aries ran three laps of the city looking for love, then took the stairs down and found someone reading on a warm bench. Sometimes the fastest move is sitting down. Who's your sprinter friend?

title: Anchorage: the crier
old_caption: Pisces cried at the sunset, a moose and one snowflake, in that order. Then Scorpio showed up with a tissue and started crying too. That's the whole love story. Who cries with you?

title: Ottawa: your pace
old_caption: Gemini lapped Taurus three times on the frozen canal without stopping talking once. Then they slowed down and listened. Are you the zoomer or the steady skater?

title: Helsinki: when the snow settles
old_caption: Taurus waited for the snow to settle before saying hi. The stars kept shaking the globe. That's the season finale and the point: there's never a perfectly still moment. Who are you waiting to say hi to?

title: Sag Has the Password
old_caption: Sag got the password and immediately banned small talk. Dinner is now a night hike. Breadsticks are allowed. Which rule would you break first?
